fields.label: Use HTTPS (TLS)
fields.description: Connect to ClickHouse over HTTPS so credentials and query results are encrypted in transit. Required when ClickHouse is reached over any non-loopback network.

fields.label: Verify TLS Certificate
fields.description: Validate the ClickHouse server certificate. Disable only for self-signed certs on a trusted network.

fields.label: Skip Airbyte Sync
fields.description: When checked, pipeline/build runs skip the Airbyte extract step and build dbt directly from existing epm_raw data (demo data or a manual load). Raw-data readiness checks pass without a connector sync.

fields.label: Airbyte Workspace ID
fields.description: Optional. When blank, the first workspace returned by the Airbyte API is used.

fields.label: Airbyte Destination ID
fields.description: Optional. When blank, konsol provisions or reuses the Open EPM ClickHouse destination.

fields.label: Airbyte ClickHouse Host
fields.description: Host used when auto-provisioning the ClickHouse destination for connector extract

fields.label: D365 Airbyte Source Definition ID
fields.description: Optional override for the D365 F&O / BC custom connector definition in Airbyte

fields.label: ERPNext Airbyte Source Definition ID
fields.description: Optional override for the ERPNext custom connector definition in Airbyte

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Shared secret for Airbyte webhook auth (X-Webhook-Secret header)

fields.label: Enable D365 Budget Write-Back
fields.description: Push approved budgets to D365 BudgetRegisterEntries (one-way; ClickHouse stays source of truth)

fields.label: Fiscal Year Start Month
fields.description: Month when the D365 fiscal year begins (1=Jan, 4=Apr, 7=Jul, 10=Oct). Maps budget period numbers to OData AccountingDate. For 4-4-5 calendars, supply a CustomFiscalCalendar programmatically. NEEDS-LIVE-TENANT: must match the Fiscal calendar configured in D365 F&O for the target legal entity.

fields.label: Entity Permission DocType
fields.description: DocType whose User Permissions restrict which entities (data areas) a user may query via the EPM API. Leave blank to allow all authenticated users to query all entities.

fields.label: Account Permission DocType
fields.description: DocType (typically a Virtual DocType proxying main account categories) whose User Permissions restrict which account categories a user may write budgets for. Leave blank to allow all authenticated users to write any account.

fields.label: Consolidation Currency
fields.description: Default currency the group consolidates and reports in (IAS 21 direct method): each entity keeps its own functional currency from D365 and is translated directly into this currency in one step. Reporting currency is per top-level group — a deployment may hold several groups in different currencies — so this is the default/fallback for a group that doesn't pin its own reporting currency, not a blanket override. Phase 2 (per-region step-by-step sub-consolidation) is tracked in grynn-in/konsolidat#93.
